# MID PENN BANK TO OPEN MALVERN FINANCIAL CENTER OCT. 19


Posted on Oct 5th, 2026


Millersburg, Pa., October 5, 2026 — Mid Penn Bank (the “Bank”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mid Penn Bancorp, Inc. (“Mid Penn”) (Nasdaq: MPB), will open its Malvern financial center, located at 101 Lancaster Ave., Malvern, PA 19355, on Oct. 19. The new financial center will be Mid Penn Bank’s second in Chester County, joining its West Chester financial center, and will complement the Bank’s existing administrative center in Malvern. The opening represents another step in Mid Penn’s continued growth throughout the greater Philadelphia area market.


Individuals and businesses in Malvern and surrounding communities will have convenient access to a full suite of traditional banking services, along with a comprehensive offering of trust, wealth management, financial advisory and insurance solutions. The new financial center will offer customers added flexibility through drive-thru banking, ample on-site parking, a state-of-the-art ATM Plus interactive teller and private meeting spaces for one-on-one financial consultations. Located along the Lancaster Avenue corridor near U.S. Route 202 and the Pennsylvania Turnpike, the office will be open Monday through Friday from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. and will be managed by Financial Center Manager Tara White.


A formal ribbon-cutting ceremony will be held Oct. 29 from 8 to 9:30 a.m. to commemorate the opening with representatives from Mid Penn Bank and the local community. A larger grand opening celebration is planned for early 2027 and will welcome customers, families and community members to visit the new financial center, meet members of the Mid Penn Bank team and enjoy food and other activities. Additional details, including the event date and time, will be announced at a later date.


### About Mid Penn Bank


Mid Penn Bank, headquartered in Millersburg, Pennsylvania, has been serving the community since 1868. The Bank operates 59 retail locations throughout Pennsylvania and central and southern New Jersey, and has total assets of approximately $7 billion. Mid Penn offers a comprehensive portfolio of financial products and services to meet the banking needs of the communities it serves. To learn more, please visit[www.midpennbank.com](https://www.midpennbank.com/) .
